propositions: Per-unit _convert invocations redundantly resolve _pandoc_timeout(), which triggers load_config() and repo_root() git rev-parse subprocesses on every call, creating 883 duplicate root-discovery processes across 884 real conversions (1,770 total Popen vs. 887 after fix).

Timeout configuration is loop/session-invariant and should be resolved once at render-pass boundary, then threaded through _render_unit and _convert via optional parameters to preserve direct-caller safe defaults and per-unit fallback behavior.

Held-out behavioral oracle with three renderable units must assert exactly one _pandoc_timeout() resolution per render pass and detect regression when timeout resolution leaks back into per-unit loops.
All 884 real production Pandoc invocations, byte-exact outputs, process-group reap behavior, and timeout configurability must be preserved; fresh trace must show at most 3 one-time git-root probes.
